description.value: Coastal Cycles is a locally owned, full-service bicycle shop in View Royal, just west of Victoria, specializing in e-bikes across Vancouver Island and the Gulf Islands. The shop is an authorized service center for Voltbike and Radpower, offering advanced diagnostics including battery capacity testing, motor and controller repair, and Bafang BESST Pro and Grin Phase Runner software support. They are also the only store on Vancouver Island cutting custom 12 and 13 gauge spokes for wheel rebuilds, and they offer e-bike rentals alongside sales.
